main_text.head: Verbalia in μῷ & τῷ.
main_text.p: Verbalia in μῷ & τῷ acuūt ultima Verbalia συλλογισμὸς, πλιγτὸς, ἀσφαρτὸς: quesi dictio ni, cui uerbū nō potest, cōponātur, accē tum traducunt, σελλωόπλητος, ἀσφαρτὸς.

Vltima uocali in nominibus per apo strophum abiecta, si supra se acutum ha-buerit ad præcedentem syllabā transfer tur, δ' ἐνα, δ' εἰν' ἔπη πέλᾳ. In aliis aūt dictio nibus cū uocali deciditur, κῷ, κατ' ἐμᾶ.
main_text.head: Quartæ.
main_text.p: Quartæ declinationis acuūt rectū. No Quartæ mina in αν & α producunt, παν, πᾶν. At πᾶν omne, suū masculinū sequitur πᾶς.
main_text.head: Fœminina in as.
main_text.p: In as fœminina, & α corripiunt, λαμ-Fœminin. πᾶς, δέκας.
main_text.head: In ais & aiξ.
main_text.p: In ais & aiξ monosyllaba, ςαῖς, δαῖς αἴξ, aus & aiξ. sed πᾶῆς contractum est.
main_text.head: Adiectiua in ης.
main_text.p: In ης adiectiua flexa per ε, ἀληθής. Adiectiua Excipe quæ plenitudinem significat πλ-λώδης: etiam quædam composita ἀμή-νης, παμμεγέθης.
